chunks: From him, from Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-‘Attar, from ‘Abd Allah ibn Sulayman, from Abi ‘Abd Allah عليه السلام, who said:

"For me to perform Zuhr in the time of ‘Asr is more beloved to me than to perform it before the sun declines; for if I perform it before the sun declines, it is not counted for me, but if I perform it in the time of ‘Asr, it is counted for me."

key_terms.تَزُولَ الشَّمْسُ: the sun declines from its zenith, marking the start of Zuhr time
key_terms.حُسِبَتْ لِي: it is counted for me as valid
key_terms.لَمْ تُحْسَبْ لِي: it is not counted for me as valid
key_terms.وَقْتِ الْعَصْرِ: the time of ‘Asr, meaning a later valid period after Zuhr has entered

ai.seo_question: Is Zuhr prayer valid if performed before zawal, or is it better to pray it later within a valid time?
ai.summary: This hadith states that performing Zuhr after its time has begun, even if delayed until the time of ‘Asr, is preferable to performing it before the sun’s decline. It emphasizes that a prayer offered before its legislated time is invalid and not counted, whereas one offered within a valid time is counted.
